metrics.label: Server disk used
metrics.definition: Capacity unavailable to uploads, including filesystem reserves. Warning at 80% used or 5 GiB free. Critical at 90% used or 2 GiB free.

metrics.label: Space available for uploads
metrics.definition: Free space shared by uploads, saved photos, database, logs and deployed services. This is not a per-user upload allowance.

metrics.label: Automatic cache cleanup
metrics.definition: Runs hourly and removes only inactive website compiler caches untouched for at least 24 hours. Active releases, photos, inventory, databases and backups are excluded. A missing, failed or more than two-hour-old result opens an issue.

metrics.label: Build cache removed
metrics.definition: Allocated size of compiler cache files removed in the latest hourly run. Zero means nothing eligible needed removal. Filesystem free space may change independently.

metrics.label: Storage upgrade
metrics.definition: If storage stays above 80% used or below 5 GiB free after cleanup, increase the server volume through the hosting provider. This dashboard does not purchase or resize storage.

metrics.label: Historical availability
metrics.definition: Monitoring history starts when this dashboard is installed. A current healthy probe is not historical uptime.

metrics.label: Customer API latency
metrics.definition: Health-check response times do not measure real customer endpoint latency.

metrics.label: Verified backup status
metrics.definition: Backup verification records are not connected.

metrics.label: Object storage use
metrics.definition: Storage capacity telemetry is not connected.
